summary.pack_description:
Collect history with the first career goals from highly-anticipated 2023-24 rookies, including Connor Bedard, Logan Cooley, Leo Carlsson, Adam Fantilli, Matthew Poitras, Bobby Brink and more!

Each pack contains 1 Opening Ice 2023-24 highlight, 1 Base 2023-24 highlight, 2 Base 2022-23 highlights, plus 1 mystery highlight that could be from Base 2023-24, Opening Ice: Elites, Opening Ice, or Making the Mark sets.

release.name: Opening Ice 2023-24 Debut LE Pack
release.description:
Sale Starts: Mon, Nov 27 at 1PM ET / 10AM PT

 

Price: $65 USD

# Packs Available: 3,500 packs total

 

Purchase Limit: Five (5) pack limit per person for the first 2 hours. Once the “Buy Now” process has started, users will have 10 minutes to complete checkout before the pack(s) is released for another collector to purchase.

 

Highlights Per Pack: 5

Pack Contents (Highlight Rarity, Edition Size):

    • One (1) highlight from Opening Ice 2023-24 (Rare #/250)
    • One (1) highlight from Base 2023-24 (Core #/1500)
    • Two (2) highlights from Base 2022-23 (Core #/1500)
    • One (1) highlight with the following probabilities:
      • 67% Base 2023-24 (Core #/1500)
      • 20% Opening Ice: Elites (Rare #/250) – First chance to find Connor McDavid, David Pastrnak, Matthew Tkachuk and Charlie McAvoy!
      • 10% Opening Ice (Rare #/250)
      • 3% Making the Mark (Epic #/100) - Last chance to find this set in a pack drop!

 

Payment Methods Accepted: Most major credit and debit cards. Payments will be made via registered payment processor MoonPay where available; where not available, payments will be processed via Stripe.

 

Fan Marketplace: Packs and highlights will be eligible to be sold to other collectors with the launch of the NHL Breakaway fan marketplace expected later in 2023.

 

Marketplace Fee: A Content-related royalty not to exceed 5% may be incurred upon resale. See FAQ.

 

Transferability: Packs and highlights can be exchanged in the Trade Lounge™ with other NHL Breakaway users.

 

Blockchain: Polygon

 

Sets Included:

  • Full Highlights List
  • Opening Ice: 2023-24, Series 1 - Preview
  • Opening Ice: Elites, Series 1 - Preview
  • Opening Ice, Series 1 - Preview
  • Base 2023-24, Series 1 - Preview
  • Base 2022-23, Series 1 - Preview (Expansion) | Preview (Original)
  • Making the Mark, Series 1 - Preview

 

Collection Guarantee: Series 1 highlights will only be distributed during Series 1, which ends ~September 2024. We will not issue more than the edition limit we have set. Any editions not distributed in packs will not be distributed after the series end date (See FAQ for “Uncirculated Editions”)

 

All sales subject to Terms

pack_series.name: Series 1
pack_series.description: Series 1 is the inaugural series of the NHL Breakaway program featuring highlights and collectibles from the 2022-23 and 2023-24 season, and curated plays from the archives that are known as some of the greatest achievements in NHL history.

summary.name: Opening Ice 2023-24
summary.description: Collect history with the first career goals from highly-anticipated 2023-24 rookies, including Connor Bedard, Logan Cooley, Leo Carlsson, Adam Fantilli, Matthew Poitras, Bobby Brink and more!

summary.name: Base 2023-24
summary.description: Get ready to relive the adrenaline-packed start of the 2023-24 NHL season – everything from game-breaking clappers to hat tricks to how-did-he-get-there saves! Featuring rising stars, savvy veterans, and comeback kings like Alex DeBrincat, Mika Zibanejad, Sean Couturier, William Nylander, Corey Perry, Mark Sheifele and more!

summary.name: Base
summary.description: The Series 1 Base set is a collection of meaningful highlights from each team in the League that occurred during the 2022-23 season.

Featuring rising stars, savvy veterans, and comeback kings like Alex DeBrincat, Mika Zibanejad, Sean Couturier, William Nylander, Corey Perry, Mark Sheifele and more!

summary.name: Opening Ice: Elites
summary.description: Introducing Opening Ice: Elites, an exhilarating set that captures the unforgettable moments when the game's current stars scored their first career NHL goal or a talented goalie secured his debut NHL victory. This exclusive collection showcases the raw talent and emotion of these rising stars as they etch their names in NHL history. Experience the sheer joy and determination as they find the back of the net or defend their crease in their milestone moments. Opening Ice: Elites is a celebration of the sport's future legends and a must-have addition to any hockey enthusiast's collection, cherishing the beginnings of remarkable careers.

summary.name: Opening Ice
summary.description: Get ready to witness the NHL’s rising stars like never before with Opening Ice. This set features 20 heart-pounding highlights from players who have notched their first career goal in the 2021-22 and 2022-23 seasons.

summary.name: Making the Mark
summary.description: Making the Mark set celebrates record-setting and career accomplishments of the recent season – moments that have the opportunity to transcend the game and become landmarks in the annals of NHL history.
